import { Download as DownloadIcon, Ellipsis as EllipsisIcon, FileSpreadsheet as FileSpreadsheetIcon, FileText as FileTextIcon, FileVideoCamera as FileVideoIcon, Folder as FolderIcon, Pencil as PencilIcon, Trash2 as Trash2Icon, } from "@designali/icons" import { Button } from "@workspace/ui/components/button" import { DropdownMenu, DropdownMenuContent, DropdownMenuItem, DropdownMenuSeparator, DropdownMenuTrigger, } from "@workspace/ui/components/dropdown-menu" import { Table, TableBody, TableCell, TableHead, TableHeader, TableRow, } from "@workspace/ui/components/table" import { cn } from "@workspace/ui/lib/utils" const files = [ { name: "Brand assets", kind: "folder", size: "—", modified: "Nov 14" }, { name: "designali-brand-guidelines.pdf", kind: "pdf", size: "8.2 MB", modified: "Nov 13", }, { name: "project-estimates-2027.xlsx", kind: "sheet", size: "412 KB", modified: "Nov 9", }, { name: "designali-showreel.mp4", kind: "video", size: "96.4 MB", modified: "Oct 30", }, ] const icons = { folder: FolderIcon, pdf: FileTextIcon, sheet: FileSpreadsheetIcon, video: FileVideoIcon, } export default function FileManagerTable() { return (
Name Size Modified Actions {files.map((file) => { const Icon = icons[file.kind as keyof typeof icons] return ( {file.name} {file.size} {file.modified} } > Download Rename Delete ) })}
) }
